note: Everything needed to reproduce the shipped core. A clean clone of this repository plus Docker is the whole toolchain. `make core` refuses to package a build whose sha256 differs from artifact.sha256 once that is recorded.

core.source_commit_note: Helaas/Flycastrophe main after the draw-call cuts (Helaas/Flycastrophe#29: vertex ranges, runs of one-triangle modifier volumes) and Deadcast's faster SH4 dynarec (#34).

submodules.note: The only submodules a GLES libretro build without Vulkan compiles. Their commits come from the source commit's own gitlinks; they are recorded here so the pins are visible without a checkout, and build-core.sh checks them.

build.compiler_flags: the toolchain's release profile (mlp1-build-flags.env): -O2 -mcpu=cortex-a55 -mtune=cortex-a55 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -DNDEBUG, link -Wl,--gc-sections; plus the pgo section's use_flags

pgo.note: Profile-guided optimization. The profile is GCC .gcda data from an instrumented build of source_commit (generate_flags) trained on an MLP1; build-core.sh checks its sha256, unpacks it into the container's /tmp/pgo and builds with use_flags. It fits source_commit only: a repin means training a new one (core/pgo/README.md). The training run is recorded below.

training.runs: Savestates from upstream Flycast issues, 60 s each with a generic input loop: Spider-Man (three, flyinghead/flycast#2191), Ecco the Dolphin (#1610), Sonic Adventure (#1600). Booted from the BIOS for 90 s with Start and A pressed: Dead or Alive 2 and Power Stone. Crazy Taxi and Sonic Adventure 2, the bench games, are left out.
training.setup: Leaf's RetroArch with the bench config, performance governors, the core's defaults with Auto Skip Frame off, quit through the command port so libgcov writes the counters.
training.instrumented_source: #29's head 2dba2ced with #34's two commits applied, built from a local checkout: the same code as 1d7ef4ed, the squash merges of both (only FLYCASTROPHE.md, README.md and flycastrophe/ differ)

toolchain.note: Public image, pullable anonymously. Always used by digest.

artifact.note: Recorded from two clean local builds in the digest-pinned image on 2026-11-10 that agreed byte for byte. The shallow source clone has no tags, so the core reports its version as the short commit. CI is the independent check: investigate a mismatch rather than overwriting this value.
